faq.a1: SoftGate Comic is SoftGate's webtoon reading portal for Myanmar readers. This demo portal is in active development.
faq.q2: Is SoftGate Comic free to use?
faq.a2: Yes, SoftGate Comic has many free webtoons. Only premium episodes require coins.
faq.a3: SoftGate Comic is a web portal. You can read in a desktop, tablet, or phone browser. Native iOS and Android apps are not listed in stores yet.
faq.q4: How do I create an account?
faq.a4: You can create an account with email and password on the registration page.
faq.q5: What if I forget my password?
faq.a5: Forgot password is a three-step form (email, one-time code, new password) prepared for mail to your main inbox. This demo does not send email or save a new password yet. While signed in, you can still change your password from Profile → Security. If you are locked out before mail ships, create a new demo account on this device.
faq.a6: Signed-in readers can delete the account from Profile → Security (password confirm). In this demo, delete applies on this device and this browser. Guests have no account to delete.
faq.a7: Use demo coin top-up on the Coins page. Coins stay on this browser only — there is no live payment method yet.
faq.a8: This demo portal uses a demo coin top-up only — no real payments are processed yet. Methods like MMQR and cards arrive with the production release.
faq.a9: Demo coins are not live purchases. Refunds apply when real payments ship.
faq.a10: New titles appear on Home New Releases. Each series follows its own update rhythm. SoftGate does not promise a portal-wide drop day.
faq.q11: How do I request a webtoon?
faq.a11: Use Contact. Name the series and why you want it. A request is not a promise we will license or publish it.
faq.q12: How do I unlock premium episodes?
faq.a12: Premium episodes unlock with coins, or become free after a Demo wait-for-free time listed on the episode. Coins skip the wait and need a signed-in wallet. Wait-for-free is not a live publisher clock or a daily 23:59 reset.
faq.a13: Your reading progress is saved on this browser. The Home page shows a Continue Reading rail so you can resume the exact episode where you left off.
faq.q14: Can I publish my own webtoon on SoftGate Comic?
faq.a14: Not through an in-portal upload. Format requirements and Send your pitch are on the Publish with Us page. That page opens Contact with a labeled pitch form.
faq.q15: Can I read without an account?
faq.a15: Yes. Guests can browse and read free episodes, and Demo wait-for-free episodes after the listed time. Coins unlock and Library need sign-in.
faq.a16: Signed-in Library holds series you subscribe to. Guests cannot persist a subscription; sign in first.
faq.a17: Notifications are an in-app list on this portal. New-episode notices are Demo only. Email and push are not sent.
faq.q18: How do I report a content concern?
faq.a18: Use Contact. Include the series title and what you saw. This demo has no public report dashboard.
faq.a19: Use the language switcher in the header. English and Myanmar are available. Your choice is saved in this browser.
faq.q20: Where is my data stored in this demo?
faq.a20: On this browser and this device. Clearing site data resets demo coins and library. This is not a production cloud account.
faq.stillNeedHelpDesc: If these answers do not cover your question, contact the SoftGate Comic team.
